Rf/Rin feedback sets gain ~10 (20 dB) and pushes f3db to about beta*gm/2piC, ~30 MHz. Because loop gain is high, the output can swing near rail-to-rail (weak-inversion vdsat ~0.1 V). The DC output is set by the feedback through vg = trip point sized from the LUT."}

PARAMS = {
    "Id":    (45e-6, 20e-6, 60e-6),   # inverter bias current (shared by N and P)
    "Ln":    (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),        # NMOS length
    "Lp":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),         # PMOS length
    "Rin":   (8e3, 3e3, 30e3),        # input resistor
    "k":     (12.0, 9.0, 18.0),       # Rf/Rin (closed-loop gain ~ k*T/(1+T))
    "vout_t": (0.9, 0.7, 1.1),        # target output DC level
}

def _scaled(lut, dev, L, vgs, vds, Id, W0=10.0):
    o = lut.op(dev, W0, L, vgs, vds, 0.0)
    r = Id / max(o["Id"], 1e-15)
    W = max(0.42, min(5000.0, W0 * r))
    r = W / W0
    return dict(W=W, gm=o["gm"] * r, gds=o["gds"] * r, cgg=o["cgg"] * r,
                gm_id=o["gm_id"], cgd=0.3e-15 * W, cdd=0.6e-15 * W)

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    CL = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Id, Ln, Lp = p["Id"], p["Ln"], p["Lp"]
    Rin = p["Rin"]; k = p["k"]; Rf = k * Rin
    vo = p["vout_t"]

    # Feedback sets the gate node: vout = vg + (vg - vin)*k  ->  vg = (vout + k*vin)/(1+k)
    vg = (vo + k * vin) / (1.0 + k)

    # Size both devices so that each carries Id at the trip point vg (inverter balanced at vout_t)
    mn = _scaled(lut, "n", Ln, vg, vo, Id)
    mp = _scaled(lut, "p", Lp, VDD - vg, VDD - vo, Id)

    gm = mn["gm"] + mp["gm"]
    gds = mn["gds"] + mp["gds"]
    cgd = mn["cgd"] + mp["cgd"]
    cg = max(mn["cgg"] + mp["cgg"] - cgd, 1e-16)
    cout = CL + mn["cdd"] + mp["cdd"] + 20e-15   # plus wiring

    # Two-node small-signal solve (vg, vout) incl. Miller Cgd
    f = np.logspace(3, 10, 1400)
    H = np.zeros_like(f, dtype=complex)
    for i, fi in enumerate(f):
        s = 2j * PI * fi
        Y = np.array([[1/Rin + 1/Rf + s*(cg + cgd), -(1/Rf + s*cgd)],
                      [gm - 1/Rf - s*cgd,           1/Rf + gds + s*(cout + cgd)]])
        b = np.array([1/Rin, 0.0])
        H[i] = np.linalg.solve(Y, b)[1]
    mag = np.abs(H)
    A0 = mag[0]
    idx = np.where(mag < A0 / math.sqrt(2))[0]
    f3db = f[idx[0]] if len(idx) else f[-1]
    iu = np.where(mag < 1.0)[0]
    fu = f[iu[0]] if len(iu) else f[-1]
    gbw = min(A0 * f3db, fu) if A0 > 1 else fu

    # Swing: weak/moderate inversion devices need ~4-5 UT of vds; loop gain holds gain till then
    vmin = max(0.08, 4.5 * UT if "UT" in globals() else 0.11)
    swing = (VDD - vmin) - vmin

    power = VDD * (Id + iref)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.R("RIN", "vin", "vg", Rin)
    n.R("RF", "vg", "vout", Rf)
    n.M("MN", "vout", "vg", "vss", "vss", "nfet", round(mn["W"], 2), Ln)
    n.M("MP", "vout", "vg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", round(mp["W"], 2), Lp)
    # Reference current sink (iref must have a path; diode-connected NMOS)
    mb = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=0.7)
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)

    return n, {"gain_db": db(A0), "f3db": f3db, "gbw": gbw, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vo, "swing": swing,
               "_vg": vg, "_gm": gm, "_gds": gds, "_Wn": mn["W"], "_Wp": mp["W"],
               "_gmid_n": mn["gm_id"], "_gmid_p": mp["gm_id"], "_loopT": gm / (gds + 1/Rf) / (1 + k)}
